summary: Computes a pan/balance factor from the dot product of a stored 3-component vector (sub-struct at this[21], components at +112/+116/+120) against a caller-supplied float vector a2, then scales and biases it as (dot * 0.60000002 + 1.0) * 0.5, producing a result in the [0.2, 0.8] range. Used by the 3D sound positioning update.

operations.description: Load the sub-struct pointer at this[21] (field this+0x54); its vector components are read from sub-struct +112/+116/+120 (fields this+0xC4/+0xC8/+0xCC).
Compute the dot product of the stored vector components (+112/+116/+120) against the input vector a2.
Scale and bias the dot product: (dot * 0.60000002 + 1.0) * 0.5, mapping the result to the [0.2, 0.8] output range.
Return the scaled and bias-adjusted value as a double.
Called by F_3DSoundPositioningUpdate (0x00405B90) to compute the stereo pan/balance factor.

unresolved: The three float globals flt_59E43C / flt_59E450 / flt_59E4E8 are not referenced by the raw source; they may back the scale literals (0.60000002, 1.0, 0.5) but this mapping is unproven.
The exact meaning of the stored vector and of the caller-supplied a2 vector depends on the 3D sound positioning caller; the [0.2, 0.8] pan range is a DERIVED interpretation.
